class.name: SteamFloatResult
class.brief_description: The outcome and typed value of a cached Steam floating-point stat read.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the cached float on success or 0.0 on failure. Check [member SteamResult.ok] to distinguish the outcomes.

members.member: Steam's single-precision stat or average-rate value widened to a Godot float. Meaningful when [member SteamResult.ok] is true. A failed read also has a value of 0.0.
